title: Zero Moisture Northern Irish Spinach Hash
description: A resinous and springy crowd-pleaser dish featuring spinach, this Northern Irish recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. It is a perfect side dish for any meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped spinach with 2 tablespoons of olive oil until it is evenly coated.
Spread the spinach mixture on a baking sheet and dehydrate in the oven for 2 hours.
In a large pan, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the diced potato and grated carrot to the pan and cook until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the dehydrated spinach, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is heated through.
